notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
We’ve been aware of the long loading times players experienced the very first time launching the game. With this update we’ve worked on improving that initial loading process so you can get into the action faster.

In addition, we fixed a small bug that prevented players from achieving 100% completion. This should now be working correctly.

The update is live and available to download now — thanks for your patience and continued support!

tags.bug: - In addition, we fixed a small bug that prevented players from achieving 100% completion.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.3
notes.content:
New Features

[list]
[*] Loading Screen Added: A new loading screen has been implemented to replace the black screen during loading times, ensuring players know the game is processing and not frozen.
[*] Fixed several cards to function as intended.
[/list]
If you have any feedback or encounter issues, let us know!

tags.bug: Fixed several cards to function as intended.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] After completing Route 3 in Duelist mode, the card selection screen now appears as intended.
[*] Achievements 19 and 20 now unlock correctly.
[*] Heart of Thorns now grants the intended 5% accuracy.
[*] Ring of Life now provides 2 health points, as expected.
[*] Dark Ring now functions as expected, as expected.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Chemical Barrel Card: Fixed an issue where the "Chemical Barrel" card gave 2 poison potion cards instead of 3, as originally intended.
[*] Challenge #6: Resolved an issue that prevented the final battle from starting, so now you can enjoy the full challenge.
[*] Duelist Mode: Updated and fully fixed, bringing smoother gameplay and more exciting duels.
[*] Slot Machine Card: Corrected a typo on the Slot Machine card for a cleaner experience.
[*] Challenge #1 Difficulty: Tweaked the difficulty for a more balanced challenge.
[*] Music Fixes: Addressed music issues in challenges #3 and #4 for an improved audio experience.
[/list]
